thread:
maria_p: Heads-up — our Q2 DP capacity is constrained (30 seats). Weve got inbound demand from NA, EU, APAC. Need a defensible allocation approach so recruiting is equitable and focused on product impact. ideas?
raj_k: Quick clarifier — are seats region-limited or a global pool?
devon_e: Global pool with region-aware routing. Suggest a simple scoring matrix: market_opportunity, product_fit, tech_readiness, onboarding_risk. Keep it one pager.
lucy_pm: Add explicit success criteria per cohort: 3 qualitative feedback sessions, 1 integration test (API & auth), and tracked KPI delta (e.g., latency, completion quality, retention).
ben_ops: Note: customers needing VPC/HSM add ~2-3 weeks onboarding. That should factor into tech_readiness or a separate gating flag.
sara_research: Prioritize partners who can provide event-level telemetry and labeled prompt/response sets. that improves eval signal and regression detection.
capacity-bot: Current Q2 DP capacity: 30 seats. Allocation: 6 internal, 4 enterprise trials reserved, 20 open.
maria_p: Proposal — of those 20 open: 8 product-led (SMB), 7 mid-market, 5 strategic. Use scoring to pick invites; keep 2 slots reserved for high-risk strategic experiments (HSM/VPC).
raj_k: Incentives? Usage credits vs paid pilot vs research credits. Pricing impacts commitment.
devon_e: Recommend mixed approach: small credits for SMB, limited-time discount for mid-market, collaborative research credit + SLA for strategic.
lucy_pm: Graduation criteria from DP -> beta: integration complete, no >5% quality regression on our evals, and cohort-specific engagement threshold met.
maria_p: Example scoring formula: 
```
score = (market_opportunity * 0.3) + (product_fit * 0.35) + (tech_readiness * 0.2) - (onboarding_risk * 0.15)
```
Use >0.6 for auto-invite; 0.45-0.6 manual review; <0.45 decline.
ben_ops: Add security/regulatory flag (HIPAA/PCI/EU-residency) that forces manual review and flags potential Private deployment path.
sara_research: Feedback loop design: weekly asynchronous pulse + two facilitated deep dives (kickoff + midpoint). collect prompt/response artifacts + annotated failure cases. build a small eval harness per partner.
maria_p: Ops ask — can we reserve 2 seats specifically for risky-but-strategic partners to test HSM/VPC onboarding?
capacity-bot: Reserved seats updated: 2 strategic-risk seats allocated. Remaining open seats: 18.
raj_k: Recruitment timeline — open invites next Monday?
lucy_pm: I'll draft invite templates & incentive tiers by Friday. I'll own the success criteria doc.
devon_e: I'll share an initial scoring sheet in #product by EOD Thurs.
ben_ops: I'll publish onboarding checklist and VPC/HSM ETA by Friday.
sara_research: I'll create an eval harness template and a sample labeled prompt set.
maria_p: Sync Wed 10am to finalize invite list and outreach plan. :thumbsup: :calendar:
